petrolsparts.ponder.pneumatic_tube.heade: Transporting Items with the Pneumatic Tube
petrolsparts.ponder.pneumatic_tube.text_: Place two Pneumatic Tube Blocks and use a few more to connect them.
If either (or both) ends are given rotational power, Pneumatic Tubes can move Items between inventories a stack at a time.
The extracted items can be filtered on the input end.
If the output end has no connected inventory, it will shoot the Items out.
The direction of transport can be inverted as long as the Tube is empty.
